messages.content: 一根載有2安培電流的電線，距離4米的點的磁場是多少？

function.name: calculate_wave_amplitude
function.description: Calculate the amplitude of an electromagnetic wave based on its maximum electric field strength. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

max_electric_field_strength.description: The maximum electric field strength of the electromagnetic wave. This is a float type value.

message.content:
**答案：**  
在距離 \(r = 4\ \text{m}\) 的地方，磁場大小為  

\[
B = \frac{\mu_0 I}{2\pi r}
   = \frac{(4\pi\times10^{-7}\ \text{H/m}) \times 2\ \text{A}}
          {2\pi \times 4\ \text{m}}
   = \frac{8\pi\times10^{-7}}{8\pi}
   = 1.0\times10^{-7}\ \text{T}
\]

---

### 計算過程說明

| 步驟 | 說明 | 數值 |
|------|------|------|
| 1 | 代入公式 \(B = \dfrac{\mu_0 I}{2\pi r}\) |  |
| 2 | \(\mu_0 = 4\pi \times 10^{-7}\ \text{H/m}\)（真空磁導率） |  |
| 3 | \(I = 2\ \text{A}\)，\(r = 4\ \text{m}\) |  |
| 4 | 計算分子：\(4\pi \times 10^{-7} \times 2 = 8\pi \times 10^{-7}\) |  |
| 5 | 計算分母：\(2\pi \times 4 = 8\pi\) |  |
| 6 | 求商：\(\dfrac{8\pi \times 10^{-7}}{8\pi} = 1.0 \times 10^{-7}\) |  |

---

### 結果

- **磁場強度**：\(B = 1.0 \times 10^{-7}\ \text{Tesla}\)（約 0.1 微特斯拉）
- **方向**：由右手螺旋定則可知，若電流向上，磁場沿圓環方向（逆時針或順時針取決於觀測點位置）。

這個結果符合安培環路定理對長直導線的預測。

So B = (μ0 I)/(2π r) = (4π×10^-7 * 2)/(2π*4) = (8π×10^-7)/(8π) = 10^-7 T? Let's compute: 4π×10^-7 * 2 = 8π×10^-7. Divide by (2π*4)=8π. So B = (8π×10^-7)/(8π) = 10^-7 T. So answer: 1e-7 Tesla.
